scope: Save As server foundation; native File menu/window handoff and Open Recent are not implemented by this slice
state: targeted JVM/JS checks passed; full qualification and landing pending
findings: Copies current edited science and presentation plus the live undo history, including inputs imported since the last save. The source saved document, journal and edited state are unchanged.
Copies every immutable entry, including retained older archives; current bound archives and stored input digests are checked before the destination manifest is published.
Genuine archive absence in older bound projects is preserved. Corrupt bound archives and active runs are refused before writing destination entries.
A destination with a manifest, entries or recovery sidecars is refused. The source cannot be its own destination.
Copied native artifacts reopen with identical facts and every artifact byte, including an unsaved source binding. No analysis is rerun by Save As.
Journal-write warnings remain in the returned SaveReceipt. A failed copy releases its destination writer.
A cancellation regression first reproduced an inaccessible held writer; the handoff now observes pending cancellation while the new writer remains owned by this scope, and closes it.
limits: Unfinished immutable destination entries can remain after a write failure; the source remains unchanged.
No native Save As menu or production-host window switch is claimed yet.
No copying or publication of private study data in these tests.
